fields.name: started_at
fields.label: Started
fields.description: The session's first priced usage, else its first edit, else its last activity. A session's cost and outcome count at its start.

fields.name: outcome_label
fields.label: Outcome label
fields.description: What became of the session's changes, decided by the evidence tier outcome_why names. Landed and Committed need local Git evidence.

fields.name: evidence_tier
fields.label: Evidence tier
fields.description: The highest tier of evidence the session reached: local Git checked its commits (Tier 2), its transcript recorded tool calls (Tier 1), or neither. No forge (Tier 3) data exists.

fields.name: git_check
fields.label: Local Git
fields.description: Whether local Git was asked about the session's commits; not applicable outside a repository or for a session that changed nothing in one.

fields.name: git_check_reason
fields.label: Local Git reason
fields.description: Why local Git has not checked the session's commits, when it has not.

fields.name: project_name
fields.label: Project
fields.description: The repository, else the working folder (home as ~); empty for a session with no working directory (No project).

fields.name: project_kind
fields.label: Project kind
fields.description: Whether the project is a repository, a folder, or none.

fields.name: branch
fields.label: Branch
fields.description: The session's last recorded branch; empty outside a repository (Not a repository) and for a repository session that recorded none (No branch).

fields.name: provider
fields.label: Main provider
fields.description: The provider of the session's main model.

fields.name: model_family
fields.label: Main model
fields.description: The model that took most of the session's cost (most of its tokens when unpriced); empty when it recorded no usage.

fields.name: cost_usd
fields.label: Cost (API $)
fields.description: The session's API-equivalent cost, priced as the Library prices it; empty when its usage has no price or it recorded no usage (Has usage).

fields.name: tokens
fields.label: Tokens
fields.description: The session's reconciled tokens, the ones its cost prices.

fields.name: files_changed
fields.label: Files changed
fields.description: Files the session edited, from its own tool calls.

fields.name: lines_added
fields.label: Lines added
fields.description: Lines its edits added; empty when its harness records no line counts.

fields.name: lines_removed
fields.label: Lines removed
fields.description: Lines its edits removed; empty when its harness records no line counts.

fields.name: kept_lines
fields.label: Kept lines
fields.description: Lines it added and still had at its end, as rework judges them; empty while its rework window is open, so the rework rate never counts rework it has not had time for.

fields.name: rework_removed_lines
fields.label: Lines reworked
fields.description: Of its kept lines, those later sessions removed within the rework window; empty while that window is open.

fields.name: kept_change
fields.label: Kept change
fields.description: 1 for a session whose changes were kept (Landed, Committed or Changed and kept), else 0.

fields.name: judged
fields.label: Outcome judged
fields.description: 1 for a session whose label judges whether its changes were kept (Landed, Committed, Changed and kept, or Reworked), else 0: Changed, too recent cannot be judged yet, and No changes and Unknown have nothing to judge. Kept share divides by it.

fields.name: judged_cost_usd
fields.label: Judged cost (API $)
fields.description: The session's cost when its outcome is judged, else empty: the cost that cost per kept change divides.

fields.name: kept_priced
fields.label: Priced kept change
fields.description: 1 for a kept change whose session has a price, else 0: what cost per kept change divides by, so an unpriced session counts in neither its cost nor its count.

fields.name: has_usage
fields.label: Has usage
fields.description: 1 when the session recorded any model usage, priced or not, else 0. A session without usage has no cost rather than an unpriced one.

fields.name: linked_commits
fields.label: Linked commits
fields.description: Commits local Git linked to the session; empty unless local Git checked it.

fields.name: landed_commits
fields.label: Commits on mainline
fields.description: Of its linked commits, those that reached mainline; empty unless local Git checked it.
